description_en: Modifies the silence timeout configuration for a voice bot instance
kebab_example: aliyun voicenavigator modify-silence-timeout-config --instance-id 12f407b22cbe4890ac595f09985848d5 --prompt '不好意思，听不见您说什么' --timeout 20 --threshold 3 --final-prompt '再见' --final-action TransferToAgent --final-action-params example-string --source-type chatbotIntent --intent-trigger Timeout --api-version 2018-06-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySilenceTimeoutConfig

parameters.description_en: The prompt that plays when the system detects no user input during the specified timeout period.
parameters.example: 不好意思，听不见您说什么
parameters.help_en: The prompt that plays when the system detects no user input during the specified timeout period
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.description_en: The duration of the silence timeout, in seconds.
parameters.help_en: The duration of the silence timeout, in seconds
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.description_en: The maximum number of times the system plays the silence timeout prompt before it performs the post-prompt action.
parameters.help_en: The maximum number of times the system plays the silence timeout prompt before it performs the post-prompt action
parameters.name: threshold

parameters.description_en: The prompt that plays after the silence timeout threshold is reached.
parameters.help_en: The prompt that plays after the silence timeout threshold is reached
parameters.name: final_prompt

parameters.description_en: Parameters for the post-prompt action, specified in a JSON string.
parameters.help_en: Parameters for the post-prompt action, specified in a JSON string
parameters.name: final_action_params

parameters.description_en: The type of source that triggers the action.
parameters.help_en: The type of source that triggers the action
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.description_en: The intent trigger for the silence timeout.
parameters.help_en: The intent trigger for the silence timeout
parameters.name: intent_trigger
